description: Replace the existing custom markdown escape implementation with the `markdown-exit` package to handle code block escaping more robustly. This change will improve the reliability of code rendering in markdown slides and reduce maintenance overhead by using a well-maintained external library.
functional_requirements: Integrate the `markdown-exit` package as a dependency to handle escaping within markdown code blocks
Update the markdown processing pipeline to use `markdown-exit` instead of the current custom escape logic
Ensure all existing markdown syntax features (links, drag functionality, etc.) continue to work correctly with the new escape handling
Update documentation to reflect any changes in markdown processing behavior
Maintain backward compatibility with existing slide markdown content
